class.name: lowlevel_control/JointImpedanceController
class.description: Joint impedance controller: tau = tau_ff + Kp(q_d-q) + Kd(qd_d-qd) per joint, running at controller_manager's configured update_rate (1000 Hz in this repo's config/controllers.yaml). Subscribes to humanoid_interfaces/JointCommand on /joint_command and humanoid_interfaces/SafetyStatus on /safety_status (zeroes torque and refuses to re-enable while unsafe). Publishes humanoid_interfaces/RobotState on /robot_state.
